feeds.title: Two Peds in a Pod
feeds.description: Two Peds in a Pod met and became friends during our pediatric residency training at The Children's Hospital of Philadelphia. In practice now for over 20 years, we are board-certified primary care pediatricians in The Children's Hospital of Philadelphia Care Network. Currently, Dr. Kardos is also on-staff at St. Mary Medical Center and Dr. Lai is also on-staff at Doylestown Hospital in Bucks County, PA. We also serve on the advisory board of Happy Healthy Kids.

feeds.title: Advocare Fairmount Pediatrics Blog
feeds.description: It seems like EVERYONE has a stomach virus right now! Here is in the info you need! Advocare Fairmount Pediatrics are a community-based Pediatric and Adolescent Medicine practice established in Philadelphia in 2009 and in Montgomery County in 2023. Advocare Fairmount Pediatrics goal is to provide excellent, accessible, comprehensive medical care to infants, children and teens in our community, from all types of families. We care for young people from birth through their 21st year.

feeds.title: Kids Plus Pediatrics Blog
feeds.description: What makes Kids Plus special, what makes our practice family so unique and so proud, is the way we continue, every day and with every patient, to meet, learn, and grow together. Kids Plus Providers are hand-picked by the doctors already leading the practice, not just for their knowledge and skill but also for their dedication and compassion. That history, that emphasis on teaching and training and working to find the right fit for both our practice and our patients, defines Kids Plus.
